pagerduty-bot: 🔥 PagerDuty: INCIDENT TRIGGERED - QuotaMapper - High 429 spike across eu-west-1 (pager: oncall@redwood). Incident ID: PD-24681
ops-bot: alert summary: ~1200 429s/min for several customers (top hits: cust-acme, cust-velox). Source: rate-limiter service (quota-mapper).
ajay (oncall): acked PD-24681 :white_check_mark: i'm on it. dropping into thread. anyone see recent deploys to quota-mapper?
sara-sre: not from me. i can pull deploy history. give me 30s.
ops-bot: recent deploys: quota-mapper: 2026-11-20T02:10Z by ci-bot (config-only) - config: /deploys/quota-mapper/2026-11-20-02:10 (kv mapping change).
leo-eng: that config change was the mapping key rename (customer_id -> tenant_id) to support multitenancy. suspect mis-map.
ajay (oncall): good call. hypothesis: new mapping defaulted to global bucket for old keys -> accidental global throttling. check logs for mapping lookup misses.
sara-sre: grabbing logs from eu-west-1 limiter pods (last 15m). snippets: ```
ERROR quota-mapper lookup failed for key customer_id: null
WARN applying fallback global_bucket for tenant_id: <NONE>
WARN throttle decision: bucket=global limit=100r/s -> 429
```
maria-support: customers reporting groups of 429s on doc generation endpoints, some on paid plans. support: open ticket count rising.
ajay (oncall): impact assessment: internal metrics show traffic for top 5 customers saw sustained 429s for ~4m. severity: P1 (customers affected + revenue impact). starting mitigation plan: (1) rollback config mapping to previous version (2) enable bypass for enterprise customers via feature-flag in rate-limiter (3) scale limiter replicas x2 if saturation.
leo-eng: I can rollback config quickly. command: ```
kubectl -n infra set configmap quota-mapper-config --from-file=quota-map=/configs/quota-mapper/2026-11-19-23:50.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/quota-mapper
```
sara-sre: pre-rollback check: current config hash: ab12f3, prev: 9f8e6d. I confirm prev mapping contains customer_id entries. proceeding to rollback in 30s.
ops-bot: PD note: ajay acknowledged; escalation not yet required.
(pause ~90s)
sara-sre: rollback applied and pods restarted. watch logs.
ops-bot: watcher: 90s after restart: 429 rate down from 1200/min -> 140/min. errors mostly for backlogged requests.
leo-eng: enabling enterprise bypass flag: ```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment rate-limiter -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"feature.enterprise_bypass":"true"}}}}}'
```
ajay (oncall): done. confirming customer tickets — maria, can you verify cust-acme traffic?
maria-support: acme still saw some 429s but throughput recovered to normal. tickets updated and customers notified.
ops-bot: scaling limiter replicas from 3 -> 6 to drain queues. ```
kubectl scale deploy/rate-limiter --replicas=6 -n infra
```
sara-sre: scaling done. CPU across pods normalized; KV cache warmups finishing.
ajay (oncall): timeline so far: 02:14 PD fired -> 02:16 hypothesis + plan -> 02:18 rollback -> 02:20 feature-bypass -> 02:21 scale -> 02:24 error rates near baseline. good work.
leo-eng: root cause initial notes: config rollout introduced key rename without backward-compatible lookup -> default fallback to global bucket. follow-ups: make mapping tolerant, add config validation in CI, guard rails to prevent global buckets on config mismatch.
maria-support: customer impact summary for tickets: cust-acme (sev2), cust-velox (sev3), cust-orion (observed). all notified with timeline & mitigation.
ajay (oncall): PD update: resolving page (PD-24681) as mitigated. leaving a follow-up task list for postmortem and runbook updates. assigning follow-ups: leo -> postmortem owner, sara -> add automated deploy-check for mapping keys, maria -> customer impact writeup.
ops-bot: pager duty: PD-24681 status set to "Mitigated" by ajay.
leo-eng: i'll take postmortem. suggest blameless writeup, include reproducer and suggested config-checker PR.
sara-sre: also propose adding a canary traffic check that flags sudden 429 bump at 5m window. PR queued.
ajay (oncall): oncall handoff: i'll be heading out at 06:00 UTC; handing to leo for overnight monitoring. leo, please ack handoff.
leo-eng: acked handoff. i'll keep watch and ping if any regression.
maria-support: closing customer-facing notes for impacted tenants; escalation path explained.
ajay (oncall): final status: services healthy, 429s back to baseline, mitigation actions performed and verified. creating incident board entry and tagging SRE/eng for follow-ups. thanks everyone. :heartpulse: 
ops-bot: incident thread closed (temporary) - keep thread for postmortem updates.
